future_ltp_3s.name: future_ltp_3s
future_ltp_3s.description: Option LTP exactly 3 seconds after the current sample timestamp.
future_ltp_3s.interpretation: Matches the default 3s sampling grid; shortest production horizon.

future_ltp_5s.name: future_ltp_5s
future_ltp_5s.description: Option LTP exactly 5 seconds after the current sample timestamp.
future_ltp_5s.interpretation: Ultra short-horizon regression target for fast sampling grids (e.g. 3s/5s).

future_ltp_10s.name: future_ltp_10s
future_ltp_10s.description: Option LTP exactly 10 seconds after the current sample timestamp.
future_ltp_10s.interpretation: Short-horizon regression target for intraday premium movement.

future_ltp_30s.name: future_ltp_30s
future_ltp_30s.description: Option LTP exactly 30 seconds after the current sample timestamp.
future_ltp_30s.interpretation: Aligns with common 10s/30s sampling; captures sub-minute repricing.

future_ltp_1m.name: future_ltp_1m
future_ltp_1m.description: Option LTP exactly one minute after the current sample timestamp.
future_ltp_1m.interpretation: Medium short-term target; smoother than 10s/30s horizons.

future_ltp_3m.name: future_ltp_3m
future_ltp_3m.description: Option LTP exactly three minutes after the current sample timestamp.
future_ltp_3m.interpretation: Between 1m and 5m horizons; captures medium intraday repricing.

future_ltp_5m.name: future_ltp_5m
future_ltp_5m.description: Option LTP exactly five minutes after the current sample timestamp.
future_ltp_5m.interpretation: Longest default horizon; captures sustained directional premium moves.

trading_day.name: trading_day
trading_day.description: Calendar trading date for the replay session.
trading_day.interpretation: Partitions rows by session; required for multi-day datasets.

expiry.name: expiry
expiry.description: Option expiry date for the contract row.

token.name: token
token.description: Exchange instrument token for the option contract.

symbol.name: symbol
symbol.description: Trading symbol for the option contract.

spot.name: spot
spot.description: Underlying index spot price at the sample timestamp.
spot.interpretation: Underlying index price used to compute option Greeks, moneyness, and chain-wide context.

ltp.name: ltp
ltp.description: Option last traded price at the sample timestamp.
ltp.formula_doc: Last traded price from option tick
ltp.interpretation: Primary premium input for Greeks, IV, and prediction targets.

bid_ask_spread.name: bid_ask_spread
bid_ask_spread.description: Difference between best ask and best bid for the option, in rupees.
bid_ask_spread.formula_doc: (ask − bid) in rupees from option tick
bid_ask_spread.interpretation: Wider spreads imply higher transaction cost and less liquidity. Spikes often coincide with fast markets or illiquid strikes.

option_vwap.name: option_vwap
option_vwap.description: Session option VWAP from exchange day average traded price (ATP) on the option token.
option_vwap.interpretation: Anchor for whether current premium is rich or cheap vs the volume-weighted session average. Distances to LTP belong in the Transformation Pipeline (Interaction), not as separate Registry features.
option_vwap.expected_range: positive; near option LTP when trading is balanced

option_bid.name: option_bid
option_bid.description: Best bid (L1) on the current option token, in rupees.
option_bid.interpretation: Raw top-of-book buy. Completes symmetry with futures_bid.

option_ask.name: option_ask
option_ask.description: Best ask (L1) on the current option token, in rupees.
option_ask.interpretation: Raw top-of-book sell. Completes symmetry with futures_ask.

spot_open.name: spot_open
spot_open.description: Index session open from exchange SNAP_QUOTE (token_day_meta.day_open).
spot_open.interpretation: Day open level for the underlying. Distances and returns vs spot belong in the Transformation Pipeline.

spot_high.name: spot_high
spot_high.description: Index session high from exchange SNAP_QUOTE (token_day_meta.day_high).
spot_high.interpretation: Running day high for the underlying as of last meta write. Distances vs spot are Pipeline only.

spot_low.name: spot_low
spot_low.description: Index session low from exchange SNAP_QUOTE (token_day_meta.day_low).
spot_low.interpretation: Running day low for the underlying as of last meta write. Distances vs spot are Pipeline only.

spot_prev_close.name: spot_prev_close
spot_prev_close.description: Index previous close from exchange SNAP_QUOTE (token_day_meta.prev_close).
spot_prev_close.interpretation: Prior session settlement / close reference. Gap and return packaging vs spot are Pipeline only.

option_open.name: option_open
option_open.description: Option session open from exchange SNAP_QUOTE (token_day_meta.day_open).
option_open.interpretation: Day open premium for this option token. Distances vs ltp belong in the Transformation Pipeline.

option_high.name: option_high
option_high.description: Option session high from exchange SNAP_QUOTE (token_day_meta.day_high).
option_high.interpretation: Running day high premium. Distances vs ltp are Pipeline only.

option_low.name: option_low
option_low.description: Option session low from exchange SNAP_QUOTE (token_day_meta.day_low).
option_low.interpretation: Running day low premium. Distances vs ltp are Pipeline only.

option_prev_close.name: option_prev_close
option_prev_close.description: Option previous close from exchange SNAP_QUOTE (token_day_meta.prev_close).
option_prev_close.interpretation: Prior session close premium. Gap and return packaging vs ltp are Pipeline only.

futures_ltp.name: futures_ltp
futures_ltp.description: Last traded price of the current-month (front-month) NIFTY index futures contract.
futures_ltp.formula_doc: futures_ltp = front-month FUTIDX LTP (rupees) as-of sample ts
futures_ltp.interpretation: Primary futures price level. Basis and premium-to-VWAP relationships vs spot/futures_vwap belong in the Transformation Pipeline.
futures_ltp.expected_range: near spot; typically within a few dozen points

futures_vwap.name: futures_vwap
futures_vwap.description: Session VWAP of the front-month NIFTY futures from exchange day average traded price (ATP).
futures_vwap.formula_doc: futures_vwap = average_traded_price (rupees) as-of sample ts on FUTIDX
futures_vwap.interpretation: Session volume-weighted futures anchor. Distances and basis packaging vs spot/futures_ltp are Pipeline Interaction only.

futures_day_volume.name: futures_day_volume
futures_day_volume.description: Cumulative traded volume for the day on the front-month futures contract (as-of sample time).
futures_day_volume.interpretation: Session activity on futures. Incremental flow = Δ futures_day_volume via Pipeline Difference.

futures_oi.name: futures_oi
futures_oi.description: Open interest on the front-month NIFTY futures contract as-of sample time.
futures_oi.interpretation: Futures positioning stock. Changes → Pipeline Difference.

futures_bid.name: futures_bid
futures_bid.description: Best bid (L1) on the front-month futures contract, in rupees.
futures_bid.interpretation: Top-of-book buy interest. Pair with futures_ask for spread and microprice via Pipeline / later controllers.

futures_ask.name: futures_ask
futures_ask.description: Best ask (L1) on the front-month futures contract, in rupees.
futures_ask.interpretation: Top-of-book sell interest. Pair with futures_bid for spread and microprice packaging.

futures_spread.name: futures_spread
futures_spread.description: L1 bid–ask spread on the front-month futures contract, in rupees.
futures_spread.interpretation: Futures liquidity / transaction-cost proxy. Spread-normalized futures steps belong in the Transformation Pipeline.
futures_spread.expected_range: typically a few ticks for NIFTY futures

bs_reiv_pred.name: bs_reiv_pred
bs_reiv_pred.description: Black-Scholes theoretical premium using the session roll IV anchor and current spot.
bs_reiv_pred.formula_doc: BS price(option_type, spot, strike, r, T, roll_iv)
bs_reiv_pred.interpretation: Baseline fair-value estimate from the re-anchor model. Compare to actual LTP to see mispricing vs the roll anchor.

dgt_reiv_pred.name: dgt_reiv_pred
dgt_reiv_pred.description: Roll-anchor LTP adjusted by Delta/Gamma/Theta for spot move and time elapsed since last roll.
dgt_reiv_pred.interpretation: Short-horizon fair value from local Greek expansion. Useful when spot moves quickly between rolls.

mid_price.name: mid_price
mid_price.description: Option book mid = (best_bid + best_ask) / 2 from L1 SNAP_QUOTE.
mid_price.interpretation: Liquidity midpoint; ignore for crossed books (ask < bid).

microprice.name: microprice
microprice.formula_doc: (ask×bq + bid×aq) / (bq + aq); falls back to mid if qty sum is 0
microprice.interpretation: Book pressure pulls the fair price toward the thinner side.
microprice.expected_range: between bid and ask when quantities > 0

microprice_bias.name: microprice_bias
microprice_bias.description: Dimensionless location of microprice in the spread: (microprice − mid_price) / bid_ask_spread.
microprice_bias.interpretation: ≈ +0.5 strong buy-side pressure; ≈ 0 balanced; ≈ −0.5 strong sell-side pressure. Independent of absolute spread width.

book_imbalance_l1.name: book_imbalance_l1
book_imbalance_l1.interpretation: +1 = all bid size; −1 = all ask size.

book_imbalance_l1_5.name: book_imbalance_l1_5
book_imbalance_l1_5.description: Cumulative (Σbid_qty − Σask_qty) / (Σbid + Σask) over five levels.
book_imbalance_l1_5.interpretation: Deeper book pressure than L1 alone.

bid_depth_l1_5.name: bid_depth_l1_5
bid_depth_l1_5.description: Sum of bid quantities across five book levels.
bid_depth_l1_5.interpretation: Displayed buy-side liquidity on the option.

ask_depth_l1_5.name: ask_depth_l1_5
ask_depth_l1_5.description: Sum of ask quantities across five book levels.
ask_depth_l1_5.interpretation: Displayed sell-side liquidity on the option.

book_depth_slope_bid.name: book_depth_slope_bid
book_depth_slope_bid.description: OLS slope of bid quantity vs level index (0 = L1 … L5) on the option book.
book_depth_slope_bid.interpretation: Negative slope ⇒ size thins away from touch (typical). Flatter / positive ⇒ deeper resting size further from L1.

book_depth_slope_ask.name: book_depth_slope_ask
book_depth_slope_ask.description: OLS slope of ask quantity vs level index (0 = L1 … L5) on the option book.
book_depth_slope_ask.interpretation: Same shape interpretation as bid slope on the sell side of the book.

dgt_prediction_error.name: dgt_prediction_error
dgt_prediction_error.description: Current market LTP minus Greek Taylor predicted fair value (dgt_reiv_pred).
dgt_prediction_error.interpretation: Positive = option trading above model fair value; negative = below. Direct signal for predicting actual LTP when the target is premium level.

delta.name: delta
delta.description: Black-Scholes Delta — sensitivity of option premium to a ₹1 move in the underlying spot.
delta.formula_doc: Black-Scholes Delta from spot, strike, IV, time to expiry, and risk-free rate.
delta.interpretation: Calls typically have positive Delta (0 to 1); puts negative (−1 to 0). Higher absolute Delta means the option behaves more like the underlying.

abs_delta.name: abs_delta
abs_delta.description: Absolute value of Delta, ignoring call/put sign.
abs_delta.interpretation: Useful for comparing moneyness across CE and PE rows. Values near 0.5 often indicate ATM options.

gamma.name: gamma
gamma.description: Rate of change of Delta per ₹1 move in the underlying spot.
gamma.interpretation: Highest near ATM and close to expiry. Rising Gamma means Delta can change quickly with small spot moves.

theta.name: theta
theta.description: Expected option premium decay from one calendar day of time passing, holding other inputs constant.
theta.interpretation: Usually negative for long options. More negative Theta means faster time decay.
theta.expected_range: typically negative; magnitude rises near expiry

vega.name: vega
vega.description: Sensitivity of option premium to a one percentage-point change in implied volatility.
vega.interpretation: Higher Vega means the option price is more sensitive to IV shifts. Largest for ATM options with more time to expiry.

vanna.name: vanna
vanna.description: Cross sensitivity of Delta to implied volatility: ∂Δ/∂σ with σ in decimal (Black-Scholes).
vanna.interpretation: Positive Vanna means Delta rises when IV rises. For a +1 vol-point move (σ += 0.01), ΔDelta ≈ Vanna × 0.01. Same for CE and PE under BS.
vanna.expected_range: signed; largest near ATM with moderate T

volga.name: volga
volga.description: Convexity of Vega to implied volatility: ∂vega/∂σ using the registry Vega (₹ per vol-point).
volga.formula_doc: volga = vega · d1 · d2 / σ (vega already /100)
volga.interpretation: Positive Volga means Vega rises when IV rises. For a +1 vol-point move (σ += 0.01), ΔVega ≈ Volga × 0.01. Also called vomma.
volga.expected_range: typically positive away from very short T

charm.name: charm
charm.description: Rate of change of delta with respect to calendar time (per day).
charm.interpretation: How much delta decays as one day of time passes, holding other BS inputs fixed. Same for CE/PE when q=0.

speed.name: speed
speed.description: Rate of change of gamma with respect to spot (∂Γ/∂S).
speed.interpretation: How gamma changes as the underlying moves. Same for CE/PE under BS.
speed.expected_range: near zero away from ATM; larger magnitude near ATM

theta_per_min.name: theta_per_min
theta_per_min.description: Converts per-day Theta to expected premium decay per minute.
theta_per_min.formula_doc: theta / 1440 (per-day Theta → ₹/min; 1440 minutes per calendar day).
theta_per_min.interpretation: More negative values indicate faster intraday time decay. Helpful for short-horizon sampling intervals.

vega_per_ivpt.name: vega_per_ivpt
vega_per_ivpt.description: Vega expressed per one implied-volatility point (1%).
vega_per_ivpt.interpretation: Shows how much premium changes for a 1% IV move — aligned with how traders quote IV.

current_iv.name: current_iv
current_iv.description: Implied volatility backed out from the current option premium.
current_iv.formula_doc: IV solved from Black-Scholes using LTP
current_iv.interpretation: Higher IV means the market prices larger expected moves. Compare to session rank for relative richness.

roll_iv.name: roll_iv
roll_iv.description: Implied volatility anchor from the last re-anchor (roll) event for this contract.
roll_iv.formula_doc: IV stored at last roll / session init
roll_iv.interpretation: Stable reference IV between rolls. Compare current_iv to roll_iv via iv_drift_from_roll to see repricing.

iv_drift_from_roll.name: iv_drift_from_roll
iv_drift_from_roll.description: Percentage drift of current IV relative to the roll IV anchor.
iv_drift_from_roll.interpretation: Positive drift means IV has risen since the last roll; negative means compression vs anchor.

iv_rank_session.name: iv_rank_session
iv_rank_session.description: Current IV's percentile rank between today's session minimum and maximum IV.
iv_rank_session.interpretation: Near 100% means IV is at session highs (expensive options); near 0% at session lows.

iv_vs_atm.name: iv_vs_atm
iv_vs_atm.description: Percentage premium or discount of this strike's IV vs ATM implied volatility.
iv_vs_atm.interpretation: Positive means richer vol than ATM (common on wings); negative means cheaper vol than ATM.

atm_iv_ce.name: atm_iv_ce
atm_iv_ce.description: Black-Scholes implied volatility of the ATM call on the loaded expiry.
atm_iv_ce.formula_doc: IV from ATM CE LTP vs spot
atm_iv_ce.interpretation: Current ATM call vol state. Computed Base chain level.

atm_iv_pe.name: atm_iv_pe
atm_iv_pe.description: Black-Scholes implied volatility of the ATM put on the loaded expiry.
atm_iv_pe.formula_doc: IV from ATM PE LTP vs spot
atm_iv_pe.interpretation: Current ATM put vol state. Computed Base chain level.

option_oi.name: option_oi
option_oi.description: Open interest on the current option token as-of sample time.
option_oi.interpretation: Strike-level positioning. Fundamental market state for options.

distance_to_max_call_oi_strikes.name: distance_to_max_call_oi_strikes
distance_to_max_call_oi_strikes.display_name: Distance to Max Call OI Strike
distance_to_max_call_oi_strikes.description: Strike distance (in strike steps) from the current strike to the call strike with highest open interest on the chain.
distance_to_max_call_oi_strikes.interpretation: Negative values mean max call OI is below current strike; positive above. Often acts as a magnetic strike level.

distance_to_max_put_oi_strikes.name: distance_to_max_put_oi_strikes
distance_to_max_put_oi_strikes.display_name: Distance to Max Put OI Strike
distance_to_max_put_oi_strikes.description: Strike distance from the current strike to the put strike with highest open interest.
distance_to_max_put_oi_strikes.interpretation: Put OI walls often act as support zones. Distance helps locate the row relative to that wall.

max_call_oi_pct.name: max_call_oi_pct
max_call_oi_pct.description: This strike's call OI as a percentage of total call OI on the chain.
max_call_oi_pct.interpretation: High values mean this strike dominates call positioning — potential resistance if spot approaches from below.

max_put_oi_pct.name: max_put_oi_pct
max_put_oi_pct.description: This strike's put OI as a percentage of total put OI on the chain.
max_put_oi_pct.interpretation: High values indicate dominant put positioning at this strike — often watched as support.

distance_to_call_build_wall.name: distance_to_call_build_wall
distance_to_call_build_wall.description: Strike distance to the nearest call strike with significant recent OI build-up (call wall).
distance_to_call_build_wall.formula_doc: Distance to nearest call OI build-up strike
distance_to_call_build_wall.interpretation: Approaching a call build wall from below may slow rallies as writers defend the level.

distance_to_put_build_wall.name: distance_to_put_build_wall
distance_to_put_build_wall.description: Strike distance to the nearest put strike with significant recent OI build-up (put wall).
distance_to_put_build_wall.formula_doc: Distance to nearest put OI build-up strike
distance_to_put_build_wall.interpretation: Put build walls below spot are often monitored as intraday support.

oi_wall_bias.name: oi_wall_bias
oi_wall_bias.description: Signed measure of whether call or put OI walls are closer to the current strike.
oi_wall_bias.formula_doc: Normalized call vs put wall proximity
oi_wall_bias.interpretation: Positive bias suggests call-side positioning dominates nearby; negative suggests put-side dominance.

pinning_pressure.name: pinning_pressure
pinning_pressure.description: Estimated tendency for spot to gravitate toward high-OI strikes near expiry.
pinning_pressure.formula_doc: OI-weighted distance to spot vs max-OI strikes
pinning_pressure.interpretation: Higher values near expiry on ATM rows may indicate pin risk — spot hugging max pain / max OI.

total_call_oi.name: total_call_oi
total_call_oi.description: Sum of open interest across all loaded CE strikes for the expiry.

total_put_oi.name: total_put_oi
total_put_oi.description: Sum of open interest across all loaded PE strikes for the expiry.

oi_abs_delta_0_20_ce.name: oi_abs_delta_0_20_ce
oi_abs_delta_0_20_ce.description: Sum of CE open interest on loaded strikes with abs(BS delta) in [0.0, 0.2).
oi_abs_delta_0_20_ce.interpretation: Deep OTM / low-delta call positioning on the ATM-band chain.

oi_abs_delta_0_20_pe.name: oi_abs_delta_0_20_pe
oi_abs_delta_0_20_pe.description: Sum of PE open interest on loaded strikes with abs(BS delta) in [0.0, 0.2).

oi_abs_delta_20_40_ce.name: oi_abs_delta_20_40_ce
oi_abs_delta_20_40_ce.description: Sum of CE OI with abs(BS delta) in [0.2, 0.4).

oi_abs_delta_20_40_pe.name: oi_abs_delta_20_40_pe
oi_abs_delta_20_40_pe.description: Sum of PE OI with abs(BS delta) in [0.2, 0.4).

oi_abs_delta_40_60_ce.name: oi_abs_delta_40_60_ce
oi_abs_delta_40_60_ce.description: Sum of CE OI with abs(BS delta) in [0.4, 0.6).

oi_abs_delta_40_60_pe.name: oi_abs_delta_40_60_pe
oi_abs_delta_40_60_pe.description: Sum of PE OI with abs(BS delta) in [0.4, 0.6).

oi_abs_delta_60_80_ce.name: oi_abs_delta_60_80_ce
oi_abs_delta_60_80_ce.description: Sum of CE OI with abs(BS delta) in [0.6, 0.8).

oi_abs_delta_60_80_pe.name: oi_abs_delta_60_80_pe
oi_abs_delta_60_80_pe.description: Sum of PE OI with abs(BS delta) in [0.6, 0.8).

oi_abs_delta_80_100_ce.name: oi_abs_delta_80_100_ce
oi_abs_delta_80_100_ce.description: Sum of CE OI with abs(BS delta) in [0.8, 1.0] (clamps |Δ|>1 into this band).
oi_abs_delta_80_100_ce.interpretation: Deep ITM call positioning; often thin on ATM-band chains.

oi_abs_delta_80_100_pe.name: oi_abs_delta_80_100_pe
oi_abs_delta_80_100_pe.description: Sum of PE OI with abs(BS delta) in [0.8, 1.0] (clamps |Δ|>1 into this band).
oi_abs_delta_80_100_pe.interpretation: Deep ITM put positioning; often thin on ATM-band chains.

option_day_volume.name: option_day_volume
option_day_volume.description: Cumulative traded volume for the day on the current option token.
option_day_volume.interpretation: Session activity at the strike. Completes symmetry with futures_day_volume.

ltq.name: ltq
ltq.description: Quantity of the most recent trade print on the option token.
ltq.interpretation: Tape intensity / burst size for the option.
ltq.expected_range: positive integers when a trade printed

total_buy_qty.name: total_buy_qty
total_buy_qty.description: Exchange full-book total buy quantity (not limited to L1–L5).
total_buy_qty.interpretation: Broad buy-side depth pressure beyond top-of-book.

total_sell_qty.name: total_sell_qty
total_sell_qty.description: Exchange full-book total sell quantity (not limited to L1–L5).
total_sell_qty.interpretation: Broad sell-side depth pressure beyond top-of-book.

total_ce_volume.name: total_ce_volume
total_ce_volume.description: Sum of day cumulative volume across loaded CE strikes.

total_pe_volume.name: total_pe_volume
total_pe_volume.description: Sum of day cumulative volume across loaded PE strikes.

otm_ce_volume.name: otm_ce_volume
otm_ce_volume.description: Sum of day cumulative volume on CE strikes strictly above spot (OTM calls; ATM excluded).
otm_ce_volume.formula_doc: sum(volume_ce) for strikes with K > spot
otm_ce_volume.interpretation: Upside-call session activity on the loaded chain.

otm_pe_volume.name: otm_pe_volume
otm_pe_volume.description: Sum of day cumulative volume on PE strikes strictly below spot (OTM puts; ATM excluded).
otm_pe_volume.formula_doc: sum(volume_pe) for strikes with K < spot
otm_pe_volume.interpretation: Downside-put session activity on the loaded chain.

ema9_slope.name: ema9_slope
ema9_slope.description: Percentage change in EMA9 over the previous one minute.
ema9_slope.interpretation: Rising slope confirms strengthening short-term trend; falling slope suggests momentum loss.

ema9_gt_ema20.name: ema9_gt_ema20
ema9_gt_ema20.description: Binary flag: 1 when EMA9 is above EMA20, else 0.
ema9_gt_ema20.interpretation: Simple trend filter aligned with golden-cross style logic on the index.

time_since_cross_min.name: time_since_cross_min
time_since_cross_min.description: Minutes elapsed since the last EMA9/EMA20 cross on the index.
time_since_cross_min.interpretation: Fresh crosses (low minutes) often coincide with trend shifts; stale crosses mean established regime.

cross_age_decay.name: cross_age_decay
cross_age_decay.description: Exponential decay weight based on minutes since the last EMA cross.
cross_age_decay.interpretation: Near 1.0 right after a cross; decays toward 0 as the cross ages. Emphasizes recent regime changes.

price_dist_from_cross_pct.name: price_dist_from_cross_pct
price_dist_from_cross_pct.description: Percentage move in spot since the last EMA9/EMA20 cross.
price_dist_from_cross_pct.formula_doc: Spot move % since last EMA cross
price_dist_from_cross_pct.interpretation: Measures how far price has traveled in the current trend leg since the cross event.

spot_rv_5m.name: spot_rv_5m
spot_rv_5m.description: Realized volatility of spot returns over the previous five minutes.
spot_rv_5m.formula_doc: Std dev of 10s spot returns over 5m window
spot_rv_5m.interpretation: Higher RV means the index has been moving more; compare to IV for vol risk premium context.

spot_rv_10m.name: spot_rv_10m
spot_rv_10m.description: Realized volatility of spot returns over the previous ten minutes.
spot_rv_10m.formula_doc: Std dev of 10s spot returns over 10m window
spot_rv_10m.interpretation: Smoother realized vol baseline than 5m; useful for detecting vol regime shifts.

iv_rv_spread_5m.name: iv_rv_spread_5m
iv_rv_spread_5m.description: current_iv (percent) minus spot_rv_5m. IV decimal values are scaled ×100; values already >3 are treated as percent. spot_rv is rolling std of per-sample % spot returns (not annualized).
iv_rv_spread_5m.interpretation: Positive ⇒ implied vol above recent realized move intensity. Useful short-horizon richness / regime filter; not a pure vol-risk-premium.
iv_rv_spread_5m.expected_range: signed; scale depends on IV% vs sample-return std

iv_rv_spread_10m.name: iv_rv_spread_10m
iv_rv_spread_10m.description: current_iv (percent) minus spot_rv_10m. Same unit convention as iv_rv_spread_5m.
iv_rv_spread_10m.interpretation: Smoother IV−RV gap than the 5m window.

opt_rv_5m.name: opt_rv_5m
opt_rv_5m.description: Realized volatility of option LTP returns over the previous five minutes.
opt_rv_5m.formula_doc: Std dev of 10s LTP returns over 5m window
opt_rv_5m.interpretation: Premium realized vol; often exceeds spot RV due to leverage and IV changes.

opt_rv_10m.name: opt_rv_10m
opt_rv_10m.description: Realized volatility of option LTP returns over the previous ten minutes.
opt_rv_10m.formula_doc: Std dev of 10s LTP returns over 10m window
opt_rv_10m.interpretation: Longer premium vol baseline for the contract row.

spot_ema20_channel_width.name: spot_ema20_channel_width
spot_ema20_channel_width.description: Spot high-low EMA20 channel width on 10-second feature-grid bars (high/low from ticks in each step interval): spot_high_ema20 − spot_low_ema20.

minutes_to_expiry.name: minutes_to_expiry
minutes_to_expiry.description: Calendar minutes remaining until option expiry from the sample timestamp.
minutes_to_expiry.interpretation: Drives Theta/Gamma intensity. Values near 0 mean expiry-day or final-hour effects dominate.

minutes_since_open.name: minutes_since_open
minutes_since_open.description: Minutes elapsed since the cash market open for the session.
minutes_since_open.interpretation: Early session (low values) often has wider spreads and vol discovery; midday stabilizes.

minutes_to_close.name: minutes_to_close
minutes_to_close.description: Minutes remaining until the cash market close.
minutes_to_close.interpretation: Last-hour rows (low values) often see gamma/theta extremes and pinning effects.

is_first_hour.name: is_first_hour
is_first_hour.description: Binary flag: 1 during the first 60 minutes after market open.
is_first_hour.interpretation: Captures opening-range behavior — often higher vol and trend establishment.

is_last_hour.name: is_last_hour
is_last_hour.description: Binary flag: 1 during the final 60 minutes before market close.
is_last_hour.interpretation: Expiry-week last hour often shows pinning, theta decay, and position squaring.

minute_of_day.name: minute_of_day
minute_of_day.description: IST minute-of-day index for the sample timestamp (e.g. 555 = 09:15).
minute_of_day.interpretation: Cyclical time feature for intraday seasonality — open, lunch, and close patterns.

days_to_expiry.name: days_to_expiry
days_to_expiry.description: Calendar days from trading day to expiry (0 on expiry day).
days_to_expiry.formula_doc: Calendar days between trading_day and expiry
days_to_expiry.interpretation: Weekly vs monthly context; 0 triggers expiry-day microstructure effects.

is_expiry_day.name: is_expiry_day
is_expiry_day.description: Binary flag: 1 when the trading day equals the contract expiry date.
is_expiry_day.interpretation: Expiry-day rows have accelerated theta, gamma spikes, and pinning — model separately if needed.

strike.name: strike
strike.description: Option strike price for this contract row.
strike.interpretation: Used with spot to determine moneyness and distance from ATM.

distance_from_spot_pct.name: distance_from_spot_pct
distance_from_spot_pct.description: Percentage distance of strike from current spot.
distance_from_spot_pct.interpretation: Positive means strike above spot (OTM for calls, ITM for puts); negative below spot.

distance_from_atm_pct.name: distance_from_atm_pct
distance_from_atm_pct.description: Percentage distance of strike from the ATM strike.
distance_from_atm_pct.interpretation: Near 0 means ATM row. CE rows are typically ≥ 0; PE rows ≤ 0 in the band layout.

distance_from_atm_points.name: distance_from_atm_points
distance_from_atm_points.description: Absolute point distance of spot from the ATM strike (spot − ATM).
distance_from_atm_points.interpretation: Signed spot displacement from ATM; positive means spot above ATM strike.

strike_distance_from_atm.name: strike_distance_from_atm
strike_distance_from_atm.description: Number of strike steps between this row's strike and ATM.
strike_distance_from_atm.interpretation: Integer moneyness grid position: 0 = ATM, +2 = two steps OTM for calls, etc.

moneyness.name: moneyness
moneyness.description: Ratio of spot to strike (spot / strike).
moneyness.interpretation: Above 1 means call ITM / put OTM; below 1 call OTM / put ITM. Strong cross-sectional driver of Delta.

is_call.name: is_call
is_call.description: Binary flag: 1 for call (CE), 0 for put (PE).
is_call.interpretation: Separates call vs put rows for models that pool both sides; affects Delta sign and payoff shape.

strike_to_spot_ratio.name: strike_to_spot_ratio
strike_to_spot_ratio.interpretation: Inverse-style moneyness; values above 1 mean strike above spot.

ltp_to_spot_ratio.name: ltp_to_spot_ratio
ltp_to_spot_ratio.description: Option premium as a fraction of spot at the current timestamp.
ltp_to_spot_ratio.interpretation: Normalized premium scale (LTP ÷ spot). Higher on ATM and high-IV regimes. Base for lag and change features in this family.

side_to_ltp_ratio.name: side_to_ltp_ratio
side_to_ltp_ratio.description: ATM+6 wing LTP sum on the contract's own side (CE or PE) divided by current option LTP.
side_to_ltp_ratio.formula_doc: ce_atm6_ltp_sum / current_ltp if CE else pe_atm6_ltp_sum / current_ltp
side_to_ltp_ratio.interpretation: For CE rows: ce_atm6_ltp_sum / current_ltp. For PE rows: pe_atm6_ltp_sum / current_ltp. Measures how much aggregate wing premium on the same side exists relative to this contract's LTP.
side_to_ltp_ratio.expected_range: positive, varies by strike and moneyness

atm_straddle.name: atm_straddle
atm_straddle.description: Sum of ATM call and put premiums at the sample timestamp.
atm_straddle.interpretation: Market's priced move magnitude to expiry. Rising straddle = vol expansion or event premium.

ce_atm6_ltp_sum.name: ce_atm6_ltp_sum
ce_atm6_ltp_sum.description: Sum of call LTP at ATM and the next five OTM call strikes (ATM, +1 OTM, …, +5 OTM).
ce_atm6_ltp_sum.interpretation: Aggregate call-side premium on the ATM wing — captures how much call premium is stacked above spot in rupee terms.

pe_atm6_ltp_sum.name: pe_atm6_ltp_sum
pe_atm6_ltp_sum.description: Sum of put LTP at ATM and the next five OTM put strikes (ATM, −1 OTM, …, −5 OTM).
pe_atm6_ltp_sum.interpretation: Aggregate put-side premium on the ATM wing — mirror of ce_atm6_ltp_sum for puts.

ce_minus_pe_atm6_ltp.name: ce_minus_pe_atm6_ltp
ce_minus_pe_atm6_ltp.description: Absolute difference between call-wing and put-wing ATM+6 premium sums.
ce_minus_pe_atm6_ltp.interpretation: Signed premium imbalance in rupees — positive when calls dominate, negative when puts dominate. Complements ce_pe_atm6_ltp_ratio with absolute magnitude.

chain_pcr.name: chain_pcr
chain_pcr.description: Total put open interest divided by total call open interest on the chain.
chain_pcr.interpretation: PCR above 1 means more put OI than call OI — often interpreted as defensive positioning.

atm_pcr.name: atm_pcr
atm_pcr.description: Put OI divided by call OI at ATM and adjacent strikes.
atm_pcr.interpretation: Localized sentiment near the money; less diluted than full-chain PCR.

iv_skew_atm.name: iv_skew_atm
iv_skew_atm.description: OTM put IV minus OTM call IV at ATM ± 5 strike steps (IV_PE(ATM−5ΔK) − IV_CE(ATM+5ΔK)). Decimal Black–Scholes σ.
iv_skew_atm.interpretation: Positive ⇒ puts richer than calls (typical equity put skew). Chain-wide level from token.chain; lag/diff via Pipeline.
iv_skew_atm.expected_range: often slightly positive for index options

iv_call_put_skew.name: iv_call_put_skew
iv_call_put_skew.description: ATM CE IV minus ATM PE IV (decimal σ).
iv_call_put_skew.interpretation: ATM side gap; complements wing skew.

iv_skew_25d.name: iv_skew_25d
iv_skew_25d.description: 25Δ put IV minus 25Δ call IV, picking strikes whose BS delta is closest to ±0.25 within [0.15, 0.35].
iv_skew_25d.interpretation: Classic risk-reversal skew; null when band lacks liquid 25Δ strikes.

iv_butterfly_25d.name: iv_butterfly_25d
iv_butterfly_25d.description: Smile butterfly: average of nearest 25Δ call and put IVs minus ATM IV (mean of ATM CE/PE when both available).
iv_butterfly_25d.interpretation: Positive ⇒ wings richer than ATM (smile); negative ⇒ flatter/inverted wings. Same 25Δ strike selection as iv_skew_25d.
iv_butterfly_25d.expected_range: typically small positive for index smiles

delta_w_volume_flow_1m.name: delta_w_volume_flow_1m
delta_w_volume_flow_1m.description: Chain sum of BS delta × traded volume over the last 1 minute (Δday_volume = volume_now − volume_1m_ago) across the loaded expiry chain.
delta_w_volume_flow_1m.interpretation: Positive ⇒ net call-delta volume (bullish dealer/buyer pressure on calls); negative ⇒ put-delta volume dominance. Generalizes beyond ATM+6 path flow.

delta_w_volume_flow_5m.name: delta_w_volume_flow_5m
delta_w_volume_flow_5m.description: Same as delta_w_volume_flow_1m over a 5-minute volume lookback.
delta_w_volume_flow_5m.interpretation: Smoother chain delta-flow than the 1m window.

call_gex.name: call_gex
call_gex.description: Sum of CE gamma×OI×spot²×0.01 over the loaded chain (1% spot-move scale, lot=1).
call_gex.interpretation: Call-side gamma exposure mass. Proxy within subscribed ATM band.

put_gex.name: put_gex
put_gex.description: Sum of PE gamma×OI×spot²×0.01 over the loaded chain (positive magnitude).
put_gex.interpretation: Put-side gamma exposure mass before netting.

net_gex.name: net_gex
net_gex.description: call_gex − put_gex (puts subtract; dealer-short / risk-reversal convention).
net_gex.interpretation: Positive ⇒ call gamma dominates; negative ⇒ put gamma dominates. RoC via Pipeline Difference — not a separate Registry feature.

chain_gex.name: chain_gex
chain_gex.description: call_gex + put_gex — total unsigned gamma×OI mass on the loaded chain.
chain_gex.interpretation: Overall gamma inventory intensity; pair with net_gex for direction.

gamma_flip_spot.name: gamma_flip_spot
gamma_flip_spot.description: Underlying level where cumulative net GEX (call − put contrib by strike) crosses zero when walking strikes low→high.
gamma_flip_spot.formula_doc: interpolate strike where cum(net_gex_by_strike) changes sign
gamma_flip_spot.interpretation: Canonical dealer gamma flip level on the loaded chain. Distances vs spot are also Registry Computed Base (gamma_flip_distance).

gamma_flip_distance.name: gamma_flip_distance
gamma_flip_distance.description: Relative distance of spot from gamma_flip_spot: (spot − flip) / spot.
gamma_flip_distance.interpretation: Positive ⇒ spot above flip level; negative ⇒ below. Current market-state metric, not a Pipeline packaging column.

synthetic_forward_spot.name: synthetic_forward_spot
synthetic_forward_spot.description: Put–call parity forward at nearest ATM strike: K + (C − P) using CE/PE LTPs.
synthetic_forward_spot.interpretation: Implied forward from the ATM straddle pair. Compare to cash spot / futures via Pipeline Diff or Interaction; Registry stores the level only.

otm_pcr_volume.name: otm_pcr_volume
otm_pcr_volume.description: OTM put volume / OTM call volume: otm_pe_volume / otm_ce_volume.
otm_pcr_volume.interpretation: Volume-side put/call pressure away from ATM. >1 ⇒ more OTM put activity than OTM call on the loaded chain.

roll_age_min.name: roll_age_min
roll_age_min.description: Minutes elapsed since the last IV re-anchor (roll) for this contract.
roll_age_min.interpretation: Young rolls (low age) have fresher Greek anchors; stale rolls may drift from market.

rows_since_roll.name: rows_since_roll
rows_since_roll.description: Number of dataset rows sampled since the last re-anchor for this contract.
rows_since_roll.formula_doc: Row counter since last roll event
rows_since_roll.interpretation: Discrete counterpart to roll_age_min at the build sampling interval.
